title: Violation Notices and the Early Renewal Discount — Lease Term Agreement Bulletin
content:
**Discount share on a like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement.** The share of the early renewal discount that a like-program renewal keeps is set by the lease violation notices dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date: two or more such notices leave none of the early renewal discount; exactly one such notice leaves half of it; no such notice leaves all of it. The early renewal discount multiplied by this share is what is subtracted from the offered rent.

**Records read.** The violation notices served on the Apartment Home Lease (notices for a breach of a lease covenant such as an unauthorized occupant, excessive noise, smoking in the unit, property damage or trash left outside), by notice date. Delinquency notices and eviction referrals are not violation notices.

| Violation notices in the 12-month span | Share of the early renewal discount kept |
|---|---|
| none | all (1) |
| exactly one | half (0.5) |
| two or more | none (0) |

**Span boundary (hypothetical dates).** With a handling date of 15 August, a violation notice dated 16 August of the previous year counts; one dated 15 August of the previous year does not.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** An early renewal discount of 25.00 dollars on a lease with one violation notice in the span: half is kept, 12.50 dollars. With two notices in the span: nothing is kept.
